de1.P4.C3.ghi_chu: Y a kiem chung dung (V xap xi 294,4 < 330 nen dap an 'Khong'). Y b MAU THUAN noi bo: dien tich toan phan lon cao 274,75 cm^2 NHO hon lon cu 282,6 cm^2 nen xet rieng tien nhom thi lon cao RE hon, khong suy ra 'ton kem hon' nhu khung dien yeu cau (dien tich xung quanh thi nguoc lai: 235,5 > 226,08). Khung y b dang luu cung ghi S_tp cho ca hai lon va ket 'vi 274,75 < 282,6 nen chi phi lon cao ton kem hon'. Can thay lam ro so sanh theo dien tich nao hoac sua de.
